notes: Same OpenAI-shaped contract as the vLLM seats (see ../serving/README.md): Wielder treats this as one seat among many.
On the owner's phone the endpoint is the in-app llama-server (see PHONE-ENGINE.md); on a LAN box it is llama-server bound to the LAN interface behind the tunnel layer.
Model is whatever GGUF the seat was started with; the seat record must name it (no silent downgrades).
